title: CHAPTER 11: IMPORTANT GOVERNMENT SCHEMES – HP AND CENTRAL

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Chapter 11 covers Important Government Schemes applicable to Himachal Pradesh.
Section 11.1 focuses exclusively on HP State Government Schemes.
Section 11.2 outlines Central Government Schemes implemented in HP.

blocks.content: IMPORTANT GOVERNMENT SCHEMES – HP AND CENTRAL

cells: Health insurance up to Rs. 5 lakh; for families not covered under central schemes; covers serious illnesses
Subsidy up to 25–30% capital investment for micro/small enterprises; for youth entrepreneurship
Monthly financial assistance (Rs. 2000–3000) to serious illness patients (cancer, thalassaemia, haemophilia, etc.)
Free bus travel for women on HRTC buses; launched 2023
Monthly stipend of Rs. 1500 to women aged 18+ meeting eligibility criteria; announced 2024
Chief Minister becomes 'guardian' of orphans; education, housing support
Self-employment loans for youth; supports EV taxis, drones, petrol pumps operated by youth
Subsidy for electric taxis for unemployed youth; part of green economy push
Free LPG connections for rural women not covered under PM Ujjwala; state-funded
Scholarships and laptops/tablets to meritorious students from government schools
Restored Old Pension Scheme for HP govt employees from 2023; one of first states to do so
Promotes culture and religious tourism through organized Yatras
Compensation to farmers for crop damage by wild animals; fencing support
Financial support for girl children's education from birth to graduation

items: Exams frequently test the distinction between state-sponsored schemes and central schemes active in Himachal Pradesh.
Remember to identify the executing departments for HP State Government Schemes versus Central Government Schemes.
PM Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY): All-weather road connectivity to remote villages; critical in HP's hilly terrain.
Jal Jeevan Mission: Piped drinking water to every rural household; HP targeting 100% coverage.
PM Awas Yojana (Gramin/Urban): Housing for economically weaker sections.
Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY: Health coverage up to Rs. 5 lakh; HP supplements with Him Care.
Vibrant Villages Programme (VVP): Development of villages on international borders; HP's Kinnaur and Lahaul-Spiti border villages covered.
Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT): Urban infrastructure; Shimla, Solan under AMRUT.
HRIDAY (Heritage City Development): Heritage conservation; Shimla included.
Smart Cities Mission: Shimla is a Smart City.
National Bamboo Mission: Bamboo cultivation and enterprise; HP has tribal bamboo craft tradition.
PM Kisan Samman Nidhi: Rs. 6000/year to farmers; HP farmers covered.
PM Fasal Bima Yojana: Crop insurance for HP's farmers.
MGNREGA: Employment guarantee; critical in HP's remote areas during off-season.
Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS): For tribal (ST) children in HP's Lahaul-Spiti, Kinnaur, Chamba tribal areas.
Project Snow Leopard: Conservation; HP's Snow Leopard habitats covered.
